sentences.text: Revenue compounded at 6.4% a year from $38.5 billion in FY2016 to $67.6 billion in FY2025 [F1][F10][F201].

The path was cyclical rather than smooth: a 20.4% jump in FY2018 to $54.7 billion [F3][D92], a 22.4% collapse in FY2020 to $41.7 billion [F5][D198], then a 12.8% rise in FY2023 to $67.1 billion [F8][D357].
The FY2020 decline came from lower end-user demand and dealer inventory reductions across all three primary segments [P59].
FY2025 revenue rose 4.3% to $67.6 billion on higher sales volume of $3.389 billion, partly offset by $817 million of unfavorable price realization [F10][D463][P13].
North America supplied 54.2% of FY2025 revenue and 3.4pp of its 4.3% growth [D513][D515][D463].
Power & Energy was the largest segment at 47.6% of revenue, growing 11.6% and adding 5.2pp, while Construction Industries fell 1.6% and subtracted 0.6pp [D757][D758][D759][D765][D766].
Power Generation sales rose 32.5% and contributed 3.9pp, with the segment increase driven by higher sales volume and favorable price realization [D894][D895][P14].
Operating income grew at a 28.6% CAGR against 6.4% for revenue, but FY2025 incremental margin was negative 69.1% as operating income fell 14.7% [F202][F201][D488][D464].
Diluted EPS fell 14.7% in FY2025 against a 17.7% net income decline, as the diluted share count dropped 3.5% [D467][D465][D483].
Operating margin of 16.5% in FY2025 sits above the 14.3% window median but below the 20.2% FY2024 high [F30][D1123][D1122].
The 3.7pp margin decline came mostly from cost of revenue, a 4.2pp drag, as unfavorable manufacturing costs of $2.148 billion largely reflected higher tariffs [D476][D490][P9].
Cost of revenue rose 11.3% against 4.3% revenue growth, lifting that line to 66.2% of revenue from 62.0% [D478][D463][D441][D388].
Net margin of 13.1% trails operating margin by 3.4pp, with a 24.0% effective tax rate and $892 million of other income partly bridging the gap [F50][F30][D1168][D449][X110].
Operating cash flow of $11.7 billion was 1.32x net income in FY2025, above the 1.16x window median [F80][F40][D450][D1158].
Machinery, Power & Energy operating cash flow rose to $12.278 billion on lower working capital requirements and lower cash taxes paid [P4].
Free cash flow fell 11.2% to $8.9 billion, a 13.2% margin below the 13.4% peer median, as capex jumped 41.9% to $2.8 billion [F100][D469][D447][D1148][F90][D470].
Capex reached 1.25x D&A, up from 0.92x, and 4.2% of revenue versus 3.1% [D452][D399][D446][D393].
Net debt widened to $26.2 billion in FY2025 from $24.9 billion, with cash of $10.0 billion against $36.2 billion of debt [D456][D403][D454][D455].
That net debt is 38.8% of revenue, better than the negative 59.4% peer median and the 67th percentile of three peers [D457][D1170][D1169].
These totals omit long-term debt due within one year, which the filer reports at $7.1 billion in FY2025 [R7].
Buybacks of $5.2 billion plus dividends of $2.7 billion equaled 89.0% of free cash flow, and the diluted share count fell 3.5% [X140][X150][D459][D483].
Total debt and net cash omit long-term debt due within one year, reported at $5.3 billion to $9.1 billion a year and $7.1 billion in FY2025, so leverage is understated [R7][X180][D455].
Net debt rose for a second year through FY2025, from $22.1 billion in FY2023 to $26.2 billion, on the same incomplete debt base [R1][D350][D456].
FY2021-FY2025 net income in the table is proxy-sourced and differs from the 10-K by up to 0.06%; the 10-K FY2025 figure is $8.882 billion [R3][F40][X20].
Revenue fell 3.4% in FY2024 to $64.8 billion, a one-year dip driven by lower sales volume [R2][F9][D410][P22].
Operating margin: a FY2026 reading below the 14.3% window median would confirm the tariff-driven cost pressure, while a return above 16.5% would reverse it [D1123][F30].
Capex: FY2026 spending above the FY2025 level of $2.8 billion would keep free cash flow margin below the 13.2% just reported [F90][D447].
Dealer inventory: management expects a machine dealer inventory build above $1.0 billion in Q1 2026, versus roughly flat a year earlier, which would lift sales volume [P16].
